high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website News18.com. The headline reads: "10 Dead as Cab Falls in 300-Metre Gorge On Jammu-Srinagar National Highway." The article is curated by Aditi Ray Chowdhury and was last updated on March 29, 2024, at 11:32 IST. The text below the headline provides additional details about the incident. It states that the accident occurred near Battery Chashma in Jammu and Kashmir's Ramban area, where a vehicle had rolled down about 300 meters
